manifest.name: dsh-greet
manifest.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that registers a greet tool.

bundle.text:
# dsh-greet bundle patch: inserts the greet tool plugin row.
# The `name` resolves through the profile's Node parent-walk to this
# package's main entry (index.js), which exports the Cordis plugin.
- insert:
    - id: greet
      name: dsh-greet

readme.text: A minimal [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that registers a `greet` tool. Everything in dsh is a plugin; this repository shows the smallest complete bundle you can publish and install.

- Registers a `greet` tool callable by the agent: `greet(name)` → `Hello, <name>!`
- No build step: plain JavaScript, installs straight from GitHub.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HDylanYueH/dsh-greet
```

Then restart the profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web
```

Ask the agent: *"Use the greet tool to greet Ada."* The model can call `greet` and receives `Hello, Ada!` as the tool result.

```
dsh-greet/
├── package.json       # declares dsh.bundle (patch: ./cordis.patch.yml)
├── cordis.patch.yml   # the layer applied when a profile lists this bundle
└── index.js           # the Cordis plugin (name / inject / apply)
